description: This file defines the ConnectionBuilder interface, a fluent API for constructing Connection objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It includes method signatures for setting connection parameters such as ID, name, credentials, URI, status, and other configuration options.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing a fluent API for building Connection instances with various configuration options.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the Connection.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Sets the name for the Connection.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Sets the credentials for the Connection.

methods.name: credentialsFromJson
methods.description: Default method to set credentials from a JSON object.

methods.name: trustedCertificates
methods.description: Sets trusted certificates for the Connection.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the Connection.

methods.name: connectionStatus
methods.description: Sets the connection status.

methods.name: failoverEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables fail-over.

methods.name: validateCertificate
methods.description: Enables or disables certificate validation.

methods.name: processorPoolSize
methods.description: Sets the command processor pool size.

methods.name: sources
methods.description: Adds sources to the connection.

methods.name: targets
methods.description: Adds targets to the connection.

methods.name: setSources
methods.description: Sets the sources of the connection.

methods.name: setTargets
methods.description: Sets the targets of the connection.

methods.name: clientCount
methods.description: Sets the number of clients for HA mode.

methods.name: specificConfig
methods.description: Adds specific configuration for a connection type.

methods.name: mappingContext
methods.description: Sets the mapping context for the connection.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Sets multiple tags for the connection.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the connection.

methods.name: lifecycle
methods.description: Sets the connection lifecycle.

methods.name: payloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Sets the payload mapping definition.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a new Connection instance.
